_comment: Asian handicap, European odds (1x2) and over/under opening truncation thresholds. Source files: /workspace/odds-data/schema/v2_0-open-lead-time-distribution-20261010.md and v2_0-open-lead-time-distribution-20261010.csv, supplied by the football analyst; generated on 2026-10-10. Grouped by bookmaker only (no league grouping this time); min_samples = 100. late_p95_lead_minutes = the P5 column of the Asian handicap row of that bookmaker (hours, converted to minutes by multiplying by 60): Macau 28.15 hours = 1689.0 minutes, Pinnacle 57.48 hours = 3448.8 minutes. The European odds and over/under markets of these two bookmakers reuse their Asian handicap thresholds. Crown, William Hill and Bet365 have no group on purpose: their samples are fewer than 100, so their opening quotes are not checked (truncation_checked = false, status stays ok); no other bookmaker's threshold is applied to them. By definition about 5 percent of every group is marked suspect_truncated; that share is not the real truncation rate.
